fixtures.name: sug
fixtures.copy:
COPY (SELECT i::INTEGER AS id,
  (CASE WHEN i % 7 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (['Alpha','alpha','ALPHA','Beta','beta_x','Gamma%','delta','Epsilon','KELVIN','x' || chr(8490) || 'ELVIN','' || chr(304) || 'stanbul','istanbul','Éclair','éclair','Straße','STRASSE','a','','_','%'])[1 + i % 20] END) AS s,
  (CASE WHEN i % 5 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE 'k' || (i % 13) END) AS g,
  (CASE WHEN i % 11 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (i * 37 % 100) - 50 END)::INTEGER AS n,
  (CASE WHEN i % 9 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ((i * 91) % 2000 - 1000) / 7.0 END)::DOUBLE AS amt,
  (CASE WHEN i < 300 AND i % 3 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (i * 17) % 1000 END)::BIGINT AS m,
  (CASE WHEN i < 300 AND i % 3 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ((i * 17) % 1000) / 4.0 END)::DOUBLE AS m2,
  (CASE WHEN i < 300 AND i % 3 = 0 THEN NULL ELSE 'v' || ((i * 31) % 500) END) AS t
FROM range(1, 5000) t(i)) TO '{path}' (FORMAT PARQUET, ROW_GROUP_SIZE 700)
